# Overview

Pure Financial LLC currently operates without an established data platform. All activities related to revenue bridge analysis, pipeline management, and operational reporting are conducted without a dedicated data infrastructure. There is no mention of existing reporting or analytics tools, and the client does not have any cloud-based or on-premises data platforms in place at this time.

Data is managed and processed via manual methods or potentially disparate systems, as there are no custom integrations or unified automated processes described. As the organization engages with financial services on a B2C basis across the US, teams typically utilize manual processes for consolidating and analyzing operational and commercial data relevant to data advisory and value creation initiatives.
